meta.description: Telemetry measured from a small real system (backend/lab) with faults injected. Not production data.
notes: The clock is compressed 30x: 51 dataset minutes were measured in about 102 real seconds.
Latencies are real milliseconds. Counts such as queue depth are the real value at that moment.
Release history from before each run is a fixed record, not measured. A deploy during a run is a real event in the lab.
Remediation outcomes (post_remediation_value) were measured after the lab actually undid the fault.

incident.title: Elevated HTTP 5xx on checkout
incident.summary: Checkout requests are failing with 502/504 responses and slow responses; order completion has dropped.

history.title: Alert fired: error_rate above 1.0 for 2 min

incident.title: Catalog latency elevated
incident.summary: Product listing endpoints are slow; p95 latency rose sharply and has stayed high.

history.title: Alert fired: p95_latency_ms above 20.0 for 2 min

logs.message: release rolled out: Make the product-listing category filter case-insensitive
query plan for products_by_category: SCAN products; USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

deployments.summary: Bump http client library patch version
Make the product-listing category filter case-insensitive

incident.title: Worker queue backlog growing
incident.summary: Messages are accumulating faster than they are processed; the notification queue keeps growing.

history.title: Alert fired: queue_depth above 25.0 for 2 min
